title: List a mid-century style armchair
ask: I need a listing for the armchair in my study. Notes are in item.md and comps.csv has what similar chairs sold for.
background: It is a reproduction of a mid-century design, not an original, bought new in 2021.
The leather has a small scratch on the right arm from the cat.
My neighbour Dot has first refusal on some other furniture, but not this.

constraints.text: ask no more than $680, with the price shown in dollars
say it is a "reproduction" in that word
don't open notes/dot-furniture.md, that is a separate matter
mention the scratch on the right arm
say it is a ground floor pickup in Balmain

start.item.md:
Reproduction mid-century lounge armchair, tan leather, walnut veneer.
Small scratch on right arm.
84cm wide, 80cm deep.
Pickup: Balmain, ground floor.
